$title: Trace the Doctrine — Author Registry Entry
description: One author in the shared registry (shared/authors.json). Authors are reusable across doctrines and referenced by id. A stub asserts nothing beyond id, display name, and status (see shared/README.md).

bio.description: Short verified biographical note. Null until verified.

dates.description: The author's life dates, if verified. These are NOT work dates and must never be used as a work date (standards section 5.1). Null until verified.

displayName.description: Display name, e.g. Justin Martyr, Augustine.

id.description: Stable slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. justin-martyr, augustine.

notes.description: Researcher notes. Never a substitute for a verified field.

status.description: Lifecycle status, see RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md section 9. A stub is status not-started.

verificationRecordIds.description: Ids of verification records covering claims in this author entry.
